guideContent: Editors can edit content and attachments across Knowledge and Drafts, including home and category pages. In Knowledge, choose Edit content to open the linked draft. Save draft and preview, check the rendered page, then Submit for review. The published page changes only after approval. The submitter can withdraw a pending request. Reviewers approve and publish or return it for changes; the submitter cannot review their own work. Published working copies stay hidden until editing resumes. Editors can update the writing-area home directly. Administrators manage category definitions, permissions, users and system configuration.
uploadInvalid: Enter an integer from 1 to 99999 MB.
aboutContent:
LuxPedia is a private knowledge platform for finding, maintaining and sharing team knowledge. AI retrieval and online Office editing are not yet connected.

The wiki uses XWiki Standard 17.10.15 LTS (LGPL 2.1 or later), PostgreSQL 16.15 (PostgreSQL License) and Publication Workflow 2.4.9. The difference between the workflow extension’s published license metadata and repository wording is documented in docs/components.md and docs/workflow.md.

LuxPedia is the name of this instance. Upstream source files, NOTICE and LICENSE files, component identifiers and administration interfaces retain their original notices. Copyright remains with the respective rights holders. Branding does not change licensing or authorization checks.
previewHint: This is the saved page as it will render after publication. Check the content below, then submit it for review. Readers still see the current published version.
withdrawHint: You can withdraw your own pending request to continue editing.
withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this review request and restore draft editing?

editArticleHint: Changes are made in a linked draft. The published article stays unchanged until approval.
editArticleUnavailable: An editable draft is not available. Check the workflow configuration or contact an administrator.
draftsEmpty: No active drafts. Published working copies reappear here when you edit their articles.
userDirectoryIntro: Browse users by role, or search by account or name. Each page shows up to 25 users. Accounts with several roles appear in each relevant folder.
draftAccessDenied: You do not have permission to open this draft. Contact an administrator.
draftOpenFailed: The draft could not be opened. Refresh the page and try again; if the problem continues, contact an administrator.
abandonedHint: This draft is hidden from active work. Saved content, attachments and history are retained. Restore it before editing or submitting.
abandonConfirm: Abandon this draft? It will leave the active list. Saved content, attachments and history will be retained for restoration.
restoreDraftConfirm: Restore this draft and resume editing its saved content?
workspaceFailed: The action could not be completed. The draft may have changed, be shared, or no longer be editable. Refresh and try again.
abandonBatchConfirm: Abandon {count} selected drafts? Saved content and history will be retained.
workspaceBatchFailed: {count} drafts could not be abandoned. They remain unchanged; refresh to check their status and permissions.
workspaceListHint: Abandon your unsubmitted drafts in batches of up to 20. Shared drafts and drafts created before ownership tracking require an administrator. Withdraw pending review requests first.
workspaceSharedHint: This draft is owned by someone else, has shared changes, or predates ownership tracking. An administrator can abandon it; you can continue editing or submit it.
